description: A combined KB with HR policies and file type validation samples

modules.title: Leave policy
modules.summary: Acme Technologies' HR leave policy (HR-POL-007 v3.1) defining entitlements for privilege, casual/sick, maternity/paternity, marriage, compassionate, award and medical checkup leave. It also sets out the HRMS-based approval workflow, the annual holiday list and an annexure of abbreviations.

modules.title: Performance metrics
modules.summary: CSV of API performance metrics sampled every 15 minutes over 24 hours on 2026-10-12 (96 rows) with timestamp, endpoint, request_count, response_time_ms and status_code columns. Traffic peaks in the afternoon UTC, mean latency is 170 ms, and a 503 latency spike occurs at 13:30Z.

modules.title: Quarterly report
modules.summary: Excel workbook with a single 'Q1 Summary' sheet reporting monthly Revenue, Expenses, Profit and Margin % for January-March 2026. Q1 revenue totals 803,800 against expenses of 566,250, giving a profit of 237,550 and a 29.6% margin, with margin improving each month.

modules.title: Manifest
modules.summary: JSON manifest describing the Sample Knowledge Base: name, description, version 1.0.0, creation date 2026-10-13 and a file count of 7. It groups the files into two sub-knowledge-bases, HR Policies and File Type Validation, and records the mcp_ocr parser engine.

modules.title: Config
modules.summary: IntelliJ-style project code style configuration (scheme 'Project', version 173) stored as XML. It enables spaces inside empty HTML tags and enforced attribute quotes, and for JavaScript forces semicolons and disables the space before function parentheses.

modules.title: Requirements
modules.summary: Pinned pip requirements for a small FastAPI web API using PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy, Alembic and psycopg, with JWT auth through python-jose and passlib. It separates core runtime packages from development tooling (pytest, ruff, mypy) and pins httpx as the HTTP client.

sections.title: About
sections.text: TaskFlow Pro 4.2 is a collaborative project management application for teams of 5 to 500 people. It combines Kanban boards, Gantt timelines, time tracking and reporting in a single workspace, and is available as a browser application and as a desktop client for Windows and macOS. This manual is written for project managers, team members and workspace administrators. Administrator-only features are marked (Admin).
sections.summary: TaskFlow Pro is a web and desktop project management tool for teams of 5-500 that combines Kanban boards, Gantt timelines, time tracking and reporting.

sections.title: Requirements
sections.text: Component Minimum Recommended Browser Chrome 118, Edge 118, Firefox 120, Safari 17 Latest stable release Desktop OS Windows 10 (22H2), macOS 13 Ventura Windows 11, macOS 15 Memory 4 GB RAM 8 GB RAM CPU Dual-core 2.0 GHz Quad-core 2.5 GHz Network 2 Mbps, ports 443 and 8443 open 10 Mbps Screen resolution of at least 1366 x 768 is required; Gantt view is best used at 1920 x 1080 or higher.
sections.summary: Lists supported browsers, desktop OS versions, minimum hardware (4 GB RAM, dual-core CPU) and network requirements for TaskFlow Pro.

sections.title: Installation
sections.text: Web: Open https://app.taskflowpro.example and sign in with your work email or your organisation's SSO provider. Desktop client: 1. Download TaskFlowPro-Setup-4.2.0.exe (Windows) or TaskFlowPro-4.2.0.dmg (macOS) from the Help > Downloads page. 2. Run the installer and accept the default install location. 3. Launch TaskFlow Pro and enter your workspace URL, e.g. acme.taskflowpro.example. 4. Sign in. On first launch, the setup wizard asks for your time zone and default notification preferences. Silent install for IT departments: TaskFlowPro-Setup-4.2.0.exe /S /D=C:\Apps\TaskFlowPro.
sections.summary: Explains how to access the web version, install the desktop client via the installer, and sign in for the first time using SSO or email.

sections.title: Dashboard
sections.text: Overview The dashboard is the first screen you see after signing in. It contains: KPI cards - Active Projects, Open Tasks, Due This Week, and Overdue (highlighted red when greater than zero). Tasks Completed per Week - a bar chart covering the last eight weeks. Recent Activity - the latest updates from projects you belong to. Click any KPI card to open a filtered task list. Widgets can be rearranged by dragging their title bar. GLOBAL SCENE: A desktop web application screenshot of the TaskFlow Pro dashboard with a dark navy left sidebar and a light grey main canvas. KEY OBJECTS: Four white KPI cards across the top read Active Projects 12, Open Tasks 87, Due This Week 14 and Overdue 3 (the last in red); below them a blue bar chart titled 'Tasks Completed per Week' rises from W1 to W8, and a 'Recent Activity' feed lists five team actions with green status dots. TEXT & LABELS: Sidebar items Dashboard (highlighted blue), Projects, Tasks, Team, Reports, Settings; header reads 'Welcome back, Priya' with a 'Search projects...' box at top right. Navigation The left sidebar provides access to Dashboard, Projects, Tasks, Team, Reports and Settings. Collapse it with the << control at the bottom. Keyboard shortcuts: Shortcut Action Ctrl+K Open global search G then P Go to Projects G then D Go to Dashboard N New task in current project ? Show all shortcuts
sections.summary: The dashboard is the landing page that summarises a user's projects, tasks and team activity.

sections.title: Project Management
sections.text: Creating a Project 1. Go to Projects and click New Project. 2. Enter a Project Name and a 2-6 letter Project Key (used as a task prefix, e.g. WEB-142). 3. Choose a Template: Kanban, Scrum, Waterfall, or Blank. 4. Set the Start Date and Target End Date. 5. Choose Visibility: Team members only, Entire workspace, or Private. 6. Click Create. The project key cannot be changed after creation. GLOBAL SCENE: A modal dialog titled 'Create New Project' overlaid on a dimmed grey background. KEY OBJECTS: Six stacked labelled input fields and two buttons at the bottom right — an outlined 'Cancel' and a solid blue 'Create'; a close 'X' sits in the top-right corner. TEXT & LABELS: Project Name 'Website Redesign 2026', Project Key 'WEB', Template 'Kanban (To Do / In Progress / Review / Done)', Start Date '2026-11-02', Target End Date '2027-02-26', Visibility 'Team members only'. Adding Team Members Open the project, select Members > Invite, and enter one or more email addresses. Each member receives a role: Role Permissions Owner Full control including deleting the project Manager Edit project settings, manage members and sprints Contributor Create, edit and comment on tasks Viewer Read-only access Invitations expire after 7 days. Guests outside your domain count toward the guest seat limit. Task Assignment Open a task and choose a person in the Assignee field, or drag a task card onto a team member's avatar on the board. A task can have one assignee and any number of watchers. Set Estimate in hours or story points and a Due Date. The Workload view shows allocated hours per person per week; members above 40 hours are flagged in orange.
sections.summary: Explains how to create projects, add team members with roles, and assign tasks.

sections.title: Reports
sections.text: Built-in reports are available under Reports: Sprint Burndown - remaining story points against the ideal line. Velocity - points completed per sprint for the last 10 sprints. Time Tracking - logged hours by person, project and week. Overdue Tasks - all tasks past due, grouped by assignee. Every report can be exported to PDF or CSV and scheduled for weekly email delivery. GLOBAL SCENE: A line chart report titled 'Sprint Burndown - WEB Sprint 14 (Nov 2 - Nov 13)' on a white background. KEY OBJECTS: A grey diagonal 'Ideal' line falls from 60 to 0 story points across days D1-D10, while a blue 'Actual' line with circular markers stays above ideal mid-sprint (plateau around D3-D4 at 52-50 points) before dropping steeply to 4 points on D10. TEXT & LABELS: Y-axis 'Story points' with ticks 0-60 in steps of 10; X-axis D1 through D10; legend at bottom right reads Ideal and Actual.
sections.summary: Describes built-in reports - burndown, velocity, time tracking and overdue tasks - and export to PDF/CSV (see figure_002.png).

sections.title: Settings
sections.text: The Settings page has four tabs: Profile, Notifications, Security (two-factor authentication, active sessions), and Workspace (Admin) for billing, seat management and data retention policies.
sections.summary: Settings covers profile details, notification channels, security options such as two-factor authentication, and workspace administration for admins.

sections.title: User Preferences
sections.text: Preference Options Default Theme Light, Dark, System System Language English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese English Time zone Any IANA zone Browser time zone Start of week Sunday, Monday Monday Date format DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD Default view Board, List, Gantt Board
sections.summary: Users can set theme, language, time zone, start of week, date format and default board view from Settings > Profile.

sections.title: Integrations
sections.text: Admins connect integrations from Settings > Workspace > Integrations: Slack / Microsoft Teams - post task updates to channels. GitHub / GitLab - link commits and pull requests via task keys such as WEB-142 in commit messages. Google Calendar / Outlook - sync due dates. Jira import - migrate projects, issues and attachments. Each integration uses OAuth 2.0; tokens can be revoked at any time from the same page.
sections.summary: Lists supported integrations (Slack, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, GitLab, Google Calendar, Jira import) and how admins connect them with OAuth.

sections.title: LEAVE POLICY
sections.text: Acme Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Document No. HR-POL-007 Version 3.1 Effective: 1 April 2026 Owner: Human Resources
sections.summary: Title block of Acme Technologies' leave policy, document HR-POL-007 version 3.1, effective 1 April 2026.

sections.title: Purpose and Scope:
sections.text: The purpose of this policy is to give employees adequate time off for rest, personal matters, health and family events while ensuring business continuity. This policy applies to all permanent and probationary employees on the company's payroll in India. Consultants, interns and contract staff are governed by their respective agreements.
sections.summary: Defines the purpose of providing employees with structured time off and states the policy applies to all permanent and probationary employees in India.

sections.title: Policy:
sections.text: The leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Leave entitlements accrue monthly and are pro-rated for employees joining mid-year. All leave must be applied for and approved through the HRMS portal; leave taken without approval is treated as Leave Without Pay (LWP).
sections.summary: States that the leave year runs January-December, leave accrues monthly, and all leave must be applied for through the HRMS portal.

sections.title: A. Privilege Leave & Casual / Sick Leave
sections.text: Leave Type Annual Entitlement Accrual Carry Forward Encashment Privilege Leave (PL) 18 days 1.5 days/month Up to 45 days Up to 15 days at year-end Casual / Sick Leave (CL/SL) 12 days 1 day/month Not permitted Not permitted PL must be applied for at least 7 days in advance for absences longer than 3 days. PL can be availed only after completing the probation period. CL/SL of more than 2 consecutive days requires a medical certificate from a registered practitioner. CL cannot be combined with PL.
sections.summary: Employees receive 18 days privilege leave (max 45 carried forward) and 12 days casual/sick leave (not carried forward); sick leave over 2 days needs a medical certificate.

sections.title: B. Maternity / Paternity Leave
sections.text: Maternity leave: 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two children, and 12 weeks for subsequent children, in line with the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961. Up to 8 weeks may be taken before the expected delivery date. Adoption: 12 weeks for a mother adopting a child below 3 months of age. Miscarriage: 6 weeks of paid leave. Paternity leave: 10 working days, to be availed within 3 months of the child's birth or adoption. Employees must have completed 80 days of service in the preceding 12 months to be eligible.
sections.summary: Female employees receive 26 weeks paid maternity leave for the first two children (12 weeks thereafter); fathers get 10 working days paternity leave within 3 months of birth.

sections.title: C. Marriage And Compassionate Leave
sections.text: Marriage leave: 5 working days, available once during employment, to be taken within 1 month of the wedding date. Proof (invitation or certificate) is required. Compassionate leave: 5 working days on the death of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent, sibling, parent-in-law). Can be applied for retrospectively.
sections.summary: Grants 5 working days marriage leave once during employment and 5 days compassionate leave on the death of an immediate family member.

sections.title: D. Award Leave
sections.text: Occasion Award Leave Employee of the Year 5 days Quarterly Star Performer 2 days 5 years of service 3 days 10 years of service 5 days Award leave must be used within 6 months of being granted and cannot be encashed or carried forward.
sections.summary: Employees recognised in the annual awards or completing 5/10 years of service receive 2-5 additional days of award leave to be used within 6 months.

sections.title: E. Official Medical Checkup Leave
sections.text: Employees aged 35 years and above are entitled to one day of paid leave per calendar year to undergo the company-sponsored annual health checkup at an empanelled hospital. The checkup report receipt must be uploaded to the HRMS portal within 7 days.
sections.summary: Employees aged 35 and above get one day of paid leave per year for the company-sponsored annual health checkup.

sections.title: Leave Approval Procedure
sections.text: 1. The employee submits a leave request on the HRMS portal with dates, leave type and reason. 2. The reporting manager approves or rejects within 2 working days; unactioned requests auto-escalate to the HOD. 3. Requests longer than 5 working days also require HOD approval. 4. HR verifies leave balance and updates attendance records. 5. The employee receives an email confirmation. Emergency leave taken without prior approval must be regularised within 3 working days of returning to work. GLOBAL SCENE: A horizontal flowchart titled 'Leave Approval Workflow' on a white background showing five rounded blue boxes connected left-to-right by arrows. KEY OBJECTS: Steps read 'Employee applies on HRMS portal', 'Reporting Manager reviews (2 days)', 'HOD approval (> 5 days leave)', 'HR verifies balance & records', and 'Confirmation emailed to employee'; a red box below the manager step labelled 'Rejected: reason recorded' is connected by a downward 'No' arrow. TEXT & LABELS: Footer note reads 'Leave of 5 days or fewer skips HOD approval. Emergency leave may be regularised within 3 working days.'
sections.summary: Leave is applied on HRMS, reviewed by the reporting manager within 2 working days, escalated to the HOD if over 5 days, then recorded by HR (see figure_000.png).

sections.title: HOLIDAYS
sections.text: The company observes 10 paid holidays per calendar year: 8 fixed holidays and 2 optional (restricted) holidays chosen by the employee from a published list. Fixed holidays for 2026 include Republic Day (26 Jan), Holi (4 Mar), Good Friday (3 Apr), May Day (1 May), Independence Day (15 Aug), Gandhi Jayanti (2 Oct), Diwali (8 Nov) and Christmas (25 Dec). Holidays falling within a period of PL are not counted as leave.
sections.summary: The company observes 10 paid public holidays per year (8 fixed national/festival holidays plus 2 optional holidays chosen by the employee); the list is published each December.

sections.title: ANNEXURE
sections.text: Abbreviation Meaning PL Privilege Leave CL/SL Casual / Sick Leave LWP Leave Without Pay HOD Head of Department HRMS Human Resource Management System Queries regarding this policy may be addressed to hr.helpdesk@acmetech.example.
sections.summary: Contains the leave summary table and abbreviations (PL, CL/SL, LWP, HOD, HRMS) used throughout the policy.
